notes.rmse_o2_pct: held-out extinction points: predicted vs observed boundary O2 (% points)
notes.coverage90_ext: share of held-out extinction points inside the 90 % predictive interval

summary: Fitted on 49 ISS flame-state points. Minimum O2 for burning: 13.7 % (90 % band 13.5-14.0 %) at a = 8.6 1/s; the BASS-II report states ~13.5 % at a = 8-12 1/s. Normal-gravity practice uses 15.4 %.
limitations: Only one campaign has flame-state data, so leave-one-campaign-out validation is not possible yet. The 5-fold CV below is within-campaign and optimistic.
Baseline = normal-gravity practice: material burns iff O2 >= 15.4 % (upward limit, BASS-II report p84).
Gravity is a campaign nominal (ISS quasi-steady, <= 2 micro-g, 2001-2002 PIMS data), not measured per test.
Pressure was not reported for the rod tests; the model is only valid at the cabin pressure they ran at.
